zh.text: 创建模组表单的「冲突模组 id」改为「关联模组 id」：支持逗号、中文逗号或空格分隔，输入后即时变成可单个删除的标签；模组详情新增「关联模组」区块，多个关联按网格展示名称、版本与安装状态，对不上号的 id 会明确标出「未找到」。
修好「关联模组 id 保存后提示成功、详情却看不到」的问题：清单里已声明的关联 id 以前被运行时的冲突子集覆盖，对方没安装或没启用时整条关系就凭空消失；现在按清单的声明列表展示，编辑表单也能正确回显。
账号管理的账号卡改为两列并排、账号内角色卡三列并排：角色卡使用横向圆角布局，圆形头像支持长按进度登录，卡片显示角色名、军团 / 联盟徽标与删除入口；鼠标悬停时用 Tooltip 显示 ISK、坐标和舰船，ISK 统计改用 K / M / B / T 国际短单位。

en.text: The mod form's "conflicting mod ids" field is now "related mod ids": split on commas, Chinese commas or spaces and turned into individually removable chips as you type. Mod details gained a "Related mods" section that lays several relations out in a grid with name, version and install state, and flags ids it cannot resolve as "Not found".

Fixed saved relations disappearing. Declared relation ids were being overwritten by the runtime conflict subset, so any relation whose target was not installed or not enabled vanished right after a successful save. The declared list is now shown as-is and the edit form prefills correctly.

Account cards in account management are now two per row with character cards three per row inside each account. Character cards use a horizontal rounded layout, a circular avatar with press-and-hold login progress, character name, corp / alliance badges and a delete action; hovering shows ISK, location and ship in a tooltip, and ISK uses the international K / M / B / T short units.
